formula_source_records.original_body:
\chi=a\times b,\quad f(x)=K\chi,\quad J(x)=D_xf(x),\quad
K=\frac G{\sqrt7}\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt2&\sqrt2&\sqrt3\\
\sqrt2&\sqrt2&-\sqrt3\end{pmatrix},\quad G=\kappa_{\rm in}\lambda_g>0 .

H_N=\frac\alpha2 I,\quad H_C=\frac12(\|p\|_2^2+\|r_c\|_2^2),
\quad H_R=\frac\beta2|z|^2,\quad E=H_C+H_R,\quad H_{\rm tot}=H_N+E.

\mathcal H=\mathbb R^6\times L^2_{\rm per}\times L^2_{\rm per}\times\mathbb R^2,
\quad \|X\|_E^2=\alpha|x|^2+\|p\|_2^2+\|r_c\|_2^2+\beta|z|^2.
X_{n+1}=T_hX_n=\Phi_h\widehat F X_n,\qquad X_n^+=\widehat F X_n.

P_{NC}=\eta f^Ty,\quad P_{CR}=\kappa z^Ty,\qquad
\dot H_N=-P_{NC},\quad\dot H_C=P_{NC}-P_{CR},\quad\dot H_R=P_{CR}.

Q_{N\to C}=\int\sum_\sigma[P_{N,\sigma}]_+,\quad
Q_{C\to N}=\int\sum_\sigma[-P_{N,\sigma}]_+,
\quad
Q_{C\to R}=\int\sum_\sigma[P_{R,\sigma}]_+,\quad
Q_{R\to C}=\int\sum_\sigma[-P_{R,\sigma}]_+.

Z_2=\Omega^T\Omega,\quad h_e=|e\cdot\Omega|^2,\quad j=I-2h_e,
\quad L(\Omega)=\frac\alpha2\max(|Z_2|,j),\quad
C(\Omega)=H_N-L=\min\{C_Z,\alpha h_e\},
\quad C_Z=\frac\alpha2(I-|Z_2|).

\dot a=\mu w\times b,\quad\dot b=-\mu w\times a,\quad
\dot\Omega=-i\mu w\times\Omega.
T_h^NX\longrightarrow\widehat F^NX\qquad\text{for each such fixed finite }N.

review_scope: Editorial fidelity, not a new mathematical certification or fresh arithmetic replay.
observations: F01: simultaneous exact map, zero/bypass, F-first chronology, full feedback, original factors and Hilbert/H1 framework preserved.
F02: pre-jump b0..b(N-1) versus post-jump b1..bN; positive parts precede port summation; no impulsive work.
F03: positive denominators; corrected/raw identity, empty-start retained ratio and separate no-backflow condition; no automatic 24/25 hybrid return.
F04: invariant floor versus changing capacity, signed preload envelope and indexed current-jump sum; no attainment or infinite-index claim.
F05: graph/full square/mixed terms; exact rational witnesses and threshold; divergent ratio is to a vanishing ceiling.
F06: actual first/third moduli prevent the precise old family even after common phase/amplitude; old return-time choice does not repair launch.
F07: analytical phase cone/order, convex weights/no wrap, 97/100 gap and 284971/300000 coefficient; post-F vector result does not assert port signs.
F08: actual feedback-coupled H1/L2 expansion, t2 native debit and z, t4 receiver store, t and t3 signed powers; fixed tuple then phase, pointwise min(h,delta).
F09: fixed nonzero detuning, strict local branch gap; derivative components renamed consistently; unknown second real coefficient retained and cancelled; O(phi4) and exact ceiling ratio.
F10: one-step strong continuity at the fixed post-F point independent of continuity of F at X; fixed-N induction separately requires encountered continuity.
F11: exact real empty-external boundary, first positive baseline raises floor only; no all-later-positive baseline or arbitrary-preload stationarity.
F12: later capacity-sized hybrid receiving/recovery, uniform duration, explicit neighbourhood, growing N and physical calibration remain open; agenda preserved without new work.
